scope: One deterministic generated default per B.C. format, every explicitly selectable serial-die option on that same sample, and separate targeted modern examples. No claim of exhaustive input, palette, decal, or historical alphabet coverage.
method: Actual bcTemplate React server render with the committed research registry enabled. Standard-library XML parsing records each emitted data-character occurrence, its nearest die/role, production fallback status and exact research unit. Every research outline is checked byte-for-byte against its claimed registry glyph.
limitations: Research-candidate is provenance, not historical validation. Profile overrides can be traced, supplied outlines or hand-built; consult each profile evidence note.

Live font text and tagged lettering embedded in artwork are recorded separately from die-glyph counts. Artwork without per-character tags cannot be counted as an alphabet. This source-level audit does not measure browser glyph bounds, paint accuracy, photographic similarity or raster-export parity.
Whitespace is counted separately. Default and explicit-selection cases intentionally overlap; totals are sample occurrences, not unique historic observations.
Named die selection alone cannot certify historical tooling, size equivalence or source completeness. Compact and motorcycle contexts remain independently qualified.

externalEvidence.title: ICBC RFQ 2013-056: Vehicle Licence Plates, with addenda
externalEvidence.supports: Three separately identified font categories in 2013; historical physical reference dimensions.
limitations: A dated procurement specification, not a current universal dimension certificate or downloadable font.
Generic small-plate height does not resolve the enlarged motorcycle height described in the 2012 government release.
Appendix C sample plates are low-resolution raster images; document-label fonts are not serial die fonts.
Seven/eight character spaces in the RFQ include the graphic separator and must not be read as seven/eight registration characters.

externalEvidence.title: Province rolls out new motorcycle laws
externalEvidence.supports: Independent official corroboration of the motorcycle lettering enlargement.
limitations: Does not give an absolute final cap height, complete alphabet, or exact contour geometry.

externalEvidence.title: New licence plate number configurations, bulletin 33
externalEvidence.supports: The contemporary passenger repertoire and format; the bulletin retains design, reflectivity and materials.
limitations: Repertoire evidence does not certify a particular U/Y/Z outline or individual plate allocation.

externalEvidence.title: BC Licence Plate Identification Guide, MV1675 (052011)
externalEvidence.supports: Official cross-class samples, including separate motorcycle presentations and utility-trailer lettering.
limitations: Illustrative sample serials and catalogue layouts are not manufacture-dated issued-plate measurements.

externalEvidence.title: BC Licence Plate Identification Guide, MV1675 (112014)
externalEvidence.supports: Side-by-side official samples of older/enlarged motorcycle, utility trailer, full-size passenger, commercial and specialty lettering.
limitations: Use the printed November 2014 edition, not the archive filename, as document dating evidence.
The sample plates are raster images, typically about 200–330 pixels wide.
Helvetica Neue and Univers embedded fonts describe document labels; they do not identify the plate serial font.

externalEvidence.title: British Columbia Passenger License Plates: 2025 and beyond
externalEvidence.supports: Context for the three original plate photographs below.
limitations: Gallery presentation supplies series context, not an exact manufacture or photography date for each image.

externalEvidence.title: A907GU, passenger U reference
externalEvidence.supports: Observed U on the new passenger series, plus qualitative G/7/0 comparison.
limitations: Oblique view, low resolution and frame obstruction prevent an exact plate-plane registration.

externalEvidence.title: A820EY, passenger Y reference
externalEvidence.supports: Observed Y on the new passenger series, plus qualitative E/8/2/0 comparison.
limitations: Low resolution and perspective; the clearest plate outline of this trio still does not establish an exact master contour.

externalEvidence.title: A250EZ, passenger Z reference
externalEvidence.supports: Observed Z on the new passenger series, plus qualitative E/2/5/0 comparison.
limitations: Low resolution and a holder covering plate corners prevent an exact plate-plane registration.

externalEvidence.title: Driver Gothic
externalEvidence.supports: The creator identifies the design as Ontario-based; this is not an identified BC font.
limitations: No fresh rendering from font software in this review; prior PlateForge study compared published specimens.

externalEvidence.title: Dealerplate — North American Plate Lettering
externalEvidence.supports: The creator lists 17 regional styles including Ontario and Quebec, with no British Columbia style.
limitations: A regional comparator, not an exact BC replacement; no font software was evaluated in this review.

externalEvidence.title: Canadian License Plate Pack 1.2.1
externalEvidence.supports: Independent BC-specific raster recreation with visibly sweeping 6/9 and a bent 7, useful as a candidate comparator.
limitations: A game-mod recreation, not manufacturer artwork or a physical specimen.
Raster atlases, not installable TTF/OTF/WOFF fonts.
Current template uses the older AB1-23C pattern and all 26 letters; do not reuse its grammar as official allocation evidence.
Template points to BeamNG's default font metrics, which are not included in this archive; this review inspected the atlas rather than claiming an independent exact game render.
Package metadata retains an older last_update field; the listing date and packed-by timestamp identify this downloaded version.

externalEvidence.title: Canadian License Plate Pack: August 12, 2023 update
externalEvidence.supports: Creator reports rebuilding the BC background/font and separating the flag from the background.
limitations: An author's description of the recreation, not validation against original tooling.
